pack_name: Global AI Governance / Treaties / International Instruments
mandatory_cross_source_questions: Which instruments are binding vs nonbinding?; Which actors/states are addressed?; Which human-sovereignty protections recur?; Which governance duties are only recommendations?; What treaty-status/currentness differences matter?; Which sources address risk management/incident governance?; Where do instruments conflict or leave gaps?; Which claims require country-specific implementation research?
required_outputs: authority map;global principles matrix;treaty-status gaps;HSA threat crosswalk;unknown/conflict register
stop_condition: Do not infer universal legal duty from soft law or non-in-force treaty

mandatory_cross_source_questions: Map AI Act roles/provider/deployer/GPAI/high-risk/prohibited/transparency duties with exact phased dates; How does 2026/1744 amend duties/dates?; Which Charter/GDPR rights constrain AI use?; Which DSA/Data Act/DGA/NIS2/CRA obligations overlap?; Which national transposition or implementation dependencies remain?; What remedies/enforcement routes exist?; Which duties map to THR-001..024?; Which control/evidence artifacts would test compliance?
required_outputs: EU actor-duty-date matrix;cross-regulation overlap matrix;rights/remedy matrix;control/evidence candidates;conflict/unknown register
stop_condition: Current consolidated version/date or national transposition uncertainty is material

mandatory_cross_source_questions: Separate executive orders/policy plans/OMB guidance/NIST frameworks/state law; Which federal actors/agencies are bound by each memo/order?; What procurement/use/governance duties are stated?; Which sources are nonbinding risk frameworks?; How does Utah current law differ from federal policy?; What preemption/federal-state questions remain open?; What evidence/records would matter for agency/provider accountability?; Which HSA threats lack binding legal coverage?
required_outputs: US authority hierarchy;federal actor-duty matrix;state/federal gap matrix;NIST control crosswalk;unknown register

mandatory_cross_source_questions: Which constitutional/privacy/personality/contract/tort/criminal/consumer/internet/cyber provisions may be relevant to each HSA threat?; Which actor elements must be proved?; What exact legal elements are required before breach/crime/liability?; Which rights/remedies/administrative routes exist?; What currentness rechecks are mandatory?; What does 2026-2030 AI Action Plan add as policy rather than law?; Which AI-specific gaps remain?; What evidence would be needed in Turkish proceedings?

pack_name: China / UK / Japan / Korea Comparative Law
mandatory_cross_source_questions: For each jurisdiction separate binding law/regulation from policy/guidance; Which actors/systems are in scope?; What current effective dates/version signals matter?; What duties exist for data, algorithms, AI services, safety, transparency or rights?; What authentic-language/translation limits exist?; Which regulators enforce?; Which HSA threats are explicitly covered or weakly covered?; Compare remedies/oversight without assuming equivalence across legal systems.

pack_name: Human Sovereignty / Neurodata / Cognitive Liberty / Dignity
mandatory_cross_source_questions: Which sources explicitly protect dignity, privacy, mental/bodily integrity, brain activity, autonomy or contestability?; Which rights are jurisdiction-specific vs soft-law concepts?; What biometric/emotion/neurodata rules exist?; What manipulation/vulnerability protections exist?; What automated-decision safeguards exist?; What is the exact scope of Chile Ley 21.383?; What cannot be inferred without CL-002 official full text?; Which HSA threat families map directly vs analogically?
required_outputs: human-rights concept matrix;binding-vs-soft-law matrix;neuro/biometric scope matrix;case-law HOLD register;HSA crosswalk
stop_condition: Do not invent universal named cognitive-liberty right or admit blocked case law

mandatory_cross_source_questions: For each jurisdiction/source map actor-duty-breach-causation-damage-remedy-defence-evidence elements; What disclosure/presumption/burden/evidence rules are visible?; Which product/tort/consumer theories could apply and with what limits?; What documentation/logs would be critical?; Where are financial responsibility/insurance mechanisms mandatory, voluntary or merely proposed?; What forum/standing/jurisdiction dependencies remain?; Which incident facts would still be insufficient for liability?
required_outputs: liability element matrix;evidence requirement matrix;remedy/defence matrix;financial responsibility map;case-candidate gate
stop_condition: Do not conclude liability when any material element remains unverified

mandatory_cross_source_questions: Build a timeline for each incident; Separate observed facts/company attribution/independent corroboration/hypothesis; Identify model/system/tool/access boundaries; What safeguards failed/changed according to sources?; What actor knowledge was public vs actor-specific?; What evidence is missing for causation/damage/legal breach?; Which HSA threats and OWASP trust boundaries are implicated?; What questions should independent investigators/regulators ask next?
